caption: Bottom-up routing: a routed unit flees as individual men. A broken squadron of 24 Cavalry (blue) has a block of infantry standing between it and its own rear edge, where it would run for refuge. Each rider perceives the infantry ahead of him and runs away from them and round them, the riders east of the squadron's centre round the east side and those west of it round the west, taking his line partly from the file-mates running ahead of him. None runs into the block and none stands still in front of it, where before the whole squadron fled north along one fixed heading into the block. The squadron's position is just the centre of its riders; there is no slot grid or flight anchor while it runs.
